summary: Complete self-contained work-order specimen: three-pane workbench with stubbed sessions, spine navigator with marked failure node and scrub anchors, six numbered tickets covering all five tool kinds with one expanded well, failed/running/empty-trace states, grotesk-plus-numeral density, and a proven 375px strip-spine with visible responsive contract. Single elevation on Turn 04; all statuses pair color with icon plus text.

claims.claim: Three-pane workbench present: left project/session sidebar with stubbed sessions, center conversation with composer, right per-session browser/files/GitHub panel
Spine-navigator signature rendered as a vertical time/progress rail with one node per assistant turn, failure node marked, scrub anchors jumping to turns
Work-order ticket component shows header numeral plus status, prose, tool rows in all five kinds (Write/Read/Edit/Bash/WebSearch), and one expanded detail well with diff
Non-happy states present: failed ticket with inline retry, running ticket with staged stub progress, explicit empty-trace note, empty attachment view
Workmanlike grotesk hierarchy with large condensed turn numerals at working density; responsive rule compresses spine to a top strip at 375px with a visible responsive note
Card-soup guard honored: exactly one elevated ticket (Turn 04); every status pairs color with icon plus text label

decisions.choice: Compact 44px-minimum ruled tool rows with mono targets wrapping to two lines, one expanded inset well per work order
rationale: Direction fixes medium rhythmic density with 44px compact rows and exactly one well open
Brief demands five tool kinds stay scannable without leaving the turn that cites them
alternatives: Two-line clamped rows that truncate mono targets with ellipsis
risks: Dense rows may feel cramped on small laptop widths before the drawer breakpoint
revisitWhen: If usability evidence shows targets misread at 44px density

decisions.choice: Elevate exactly one ticket (Turn 04, active/selected); all other tickets flat with 1px rules; tool rows never carded
rationale: Direction card-soup guard is absolute: depth means job state, emphasis comes from numerals and labels
Failed state already carries red node, pill, icon, and inline error so it needs no shadow
alternatives: Elevate every ticket with soft shadows for visual richness
Elevate failed tickets additionally to draw the eye
risks: Reviewers may read flat tickets as unfinished
revisitWhen: If selection and failure must be visible simultaneously in the same viewport

decisions.choice: Below 480px the spine becomes a horizontal top progress strip, wings stack as labelled drawer sections, composer stays docked, plus a visible responsive note stating the contract
rationale: Hard floor C-T6 and C-P3 forbid page h-scroll and require drawer/tab collapse with a reachable composer
Direction requires the 375px strip-spine fallback to be proven, not sketched
alternatives: Hide sidebars below 700px behind icon buttons with no explanation
Allow horizontal page scroll on narrow screens
risks: Stacked drawers lengthen the page on phones
revisitWhen: If surface architecture later picks tabs over stacked drawers

risks: Staged stub-duration progress can read as fake determinism; labels stay honest by calling out synthetic stub steps
The spine plus two sidebars can crowd mid widths; the 1100px breakpoint stacks the right wing before legibility suffers
